slides.heading: 1 · The gate
slides.sub: Models regulated, access unequal, AI narrative toxic.

slides.heading: 2 · The trap
slides.sub: Everyone is building the same mimetic slop on rented intelligence.

slides.heading: 3 · The shift
slides.sub: Early adopters want an owned center, not another chatbot.

slides.heading: 4 · The sovereign individual
slides.sub: At the center. Ecosystem around them — software, school, community, capital.

slides.heading: 5 · The product
slides.sub: Self-improving environment, swappable models, agent-native system of record.

slides.heading: 6 · The proof
slides.sub: Center Study and businesses that improve overnight. Live loops, not demos.

slides.heading: 7 · First business
slides.sub: Education / transformation. ~$250k run rate. 1–3 FDEs per cluster.

slides.heading: 8 · Customers
slides.sub: DoorDash and Pallet — what actually runs today.

slides.heading: 9 · Growth
slides.sub: Founder-first distribution. Mimetic spread. Clone the machine.

slides.heading: 10 · The ask
slides.sub: $10M — FDE team, narrative, run more businesses, own the layer beneath the gate.
